verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents AuthKit as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server for protecting access to your own MCP server, and lists built-in support for MCP and OAuth applications. RBAC docs say access is enforced through session JWTs, which partly covers verifiable tokens. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-scope token issuance for MCP clients, details on token verification (e.g. JWKS or introspection) at the MCP server, any mention of dynamic client registration or protected-resource metadata, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
